title: 第二十六章融合
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
他压低了声音。

    “你说的那些破烂，在凡人眼里是祖传的镇宅之宝，是从地里挖出来的神器。”

    “供在祠堂里，烧香拜着，可在我们修士眼里，那就是些个灵气散尽的废铜烂铁。”

    “我安家有专门的人手，走村串户，低价把这些玩意儿收上来。”

    “一件不值几个钱，可架不住量大，收上来，回炉重炼，或是卖给那些个修补法器的散修，多少能挣点。”

    “蚊子腿也是肉嘛。”

    叶凡端着茶盏，没动。

    可他心口那块小炉，像是被这话点着了。

    流落凡间的废旧法器。

    安家有现成的渠道，低价收，量还大。

    这不就是他做梦都想找的进货门路?

    他这趟下山，本来还愁着怎么一村一镇地自己去淘。

    没想到，刚进城吃顿饭，财神爷连货源带销路，一并送上门了。

    叶凡脸上半点没显，只淡地嗯了一声，像是随口听个新鲜。

    “原来还有这门道。长见识了。”

    安庆远见他没什么反应，也没多想，只当这外门弟子是头回下山，听个稀奇。

    可叶凡心里头，已经盘算开了。

    他放下茶盏，状似无意地开了口。

    “安公子，我倒是有个不情之请。”

    “叶兄请讲。”

    “您方才说的那些破烂法器。”

    叶凡斟酌着。

    “我能不能，从您这儿收一批?”

    安庆远一怔。

    “你收那玩意儿作甚?那都是些废物，连灵气都没了。”

    叶凡早想好了说辞。

    “我那废阁，管着宗门的废弃物。”

    他半真半假。

    “上头交代了，要收集些旧法器残件回炉，我自个儿去淘太慢，您这儿现成的，省事。”

    “价钱好商量，绝不让安公子吃亏。”

    这理由编得滴水不漏。

    废阁本就是干这个的，他叶凡说要收废法器，谁也挑不出毛病。

    安庆远盯着他看了两眼。

    他心里头多少有点意外。

    这破烂玩意儿，往日都是论斤贱卖的，还从没见谁主动开口要收。

    可商人重利。有人买，就有钱赚。管他买去做什么。

    “成。”

    安庆远一拍桌。

    “这有何难。”

    “我先给你凑一批样货送去。你看看成色，合用了，往后要多少，我给你多少。”

    “价钱嘛。”

    他笑了笑。

    “都是自家兄弟，给你按收来的本钱走，添个跑腿的辛苦费，绝不宰你。”

    叶凡拱手。

    “那就多谢安公子了。”

    两件事，谈成了。

    安庆远从袖里摸出一枚小巧的玉牌，递了过来。

    “这是我安家旁支子弟用的联络信物，你拿着，往后有事，去城里任何一家挂着‘安’字号的铺子，亮一亮，自有人替你传话给我。”

    叶凡接过玉牌，入手温润，上头一个小小的“安”字。

    他也回赠了个寻常的物件，从黑市顺手买的一枚刻字木牌，权当个记认。

    信物一换，这交情就算落了地。
content_en:
He lowered his voice.

    "Those rags you mentioned are, in the eyes of mortals, ancestral treasures and artifacts dug out of the ground."

    "They are offered in the ancestral hall, burned with incense and worshiped, but in the eyes of us monks, they are just scraps of copper and iron that have lost their spiritual energy."

    "My An family has dedicated staff who go from village to village and collect these things at low prices."

    "One piece is not worth much, but it can't handle the large quantity. You can collect it and resmelt it, or sell it to casual cultivators who repair magic weapons. You can make some money."

    "Mosquito legs are also meat."

    Ye Fan held the tea cup and did not move.

    But the little furnace in his heart seemed to be ignited by these words.

    A discarded magical weapon wandering around the world.

    Anjia has ready-made channels, low prices and large quantities.

    Isn't this the way to purchase goods that he has always dreamed of finding?

    When he went down the mountain, he was originally worried about how he would go shopping in villages and towns by himself.

    Unexpectedly, as soon as I entered the city for a meal, the God of Wealth delivered goods and sales to my door.

    Ye Fan didn't show anything on his face, he just hummed lightly, as if he was hearing something new casually.

    "It turns out there is such a way. I have learned a lot."

    An Qing Yuan saw that he had no reaction and didn't think much about it. He just thought that this outer disciple was coming down the mountain for the first time and it was a surprise.

    But Ye Fan had already made plans in his heart.

    He put down the tea cup and opened his mouth as if unintentionally.

    "Mr. An, I have a merciless request."

    "Brother Ye, please speak."

    "Those broken magic weapons you just mentioned."

    Ye Fan considered it.

    "Can I collect a batch from you?"

    An Qingyuan was startled.

    "Why did you collect those things? They are all rubbish, they even have no spiritual energy."

    Ye Fan had already thought of his words.

    "My Abandoned Pavilion is in charge of the sect's waste."

    He was half-truthful.

    "I have been told by my superiors that we need to collect some old magical artifact remnants and return them to the furnace. It would be too slow for me to search for them myself. You have them here ready-made, which saves trouble."

    "The price is negotiable and Mr. An will never suffer a loss."

    This reason is watertight.

    This is what Feige is doing. Ye Fan said that he wanted to collect the scrapped magic weapons, and no one could find fault with it.

    An Qingyuan stared at him twice.

    He was somewhat surprised.

    In the past, these junk things were sold at low prices, but I have never seen anyone take the initiative to take them.

    But businessmen can make huge profits. If someone buys it, money will be made. No matter what he buys it for.

    "It's done."

    An Qingyuan slapped the table.

    "How difficult is this?"

    "I will collect a batch of samples for you first. You can check the quality and see if they are suitable for use. I will give you as much as you want."

    "It's the price."

    He smiled.

    "They're all my brothers. I'll give you the money I received. I'll add a fee for running errands. I won't kill you."

    Ye Fan handed over his hand.

    "Then thank you Mr. An."

    Two things were negotiated.

    An Qingyuan took out a small jade plaque from his sleeve and handed it over.

    "This is a communication token used by my descendants from the An family. Take it and if you have something to do in the future, go to any shop with the word 'An' in the city and shine it, and someone will send a message to me on your behalf."

    Ye Fan took the jade token and started to wear it warmly, with a small word "安" on it.

    He also gave back an ordinary object, an engraved wooden plaque he bought from the black market, which he used as a token of recognition.

    Once the tokens are exchanged, the friendship is over.
